verifiedScope.proxy: Selected lifetime Japanese prose-fiction first-periodical-publication window, from Rashōmon to Kappa, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The four markers use original Japanese magazine publication years, not composition, later book collections, reissues, translations or adaptations; familiar English titles are supplied for readability. Rashōmon appeared in Teikoku Bungaku in November 1915, The Nose in Shinshichō in February 1916, In a Grove in Shinchō in January 1922, and Kappa in Kaizō in March 1927, before his July death. In a Grove’s text carries a December 1921 dateline, which is not its first-publication date. Earlier and unselected fiction, essays, poetry and posthumous releases are outside this selection; the bar is not a complete account of his literary activity.
